data.name:
Offline Root CA
(Air-Gapped)
data.description: Offline root certificate authority signing intermediate certificates only.

threats.title: Root CA Key Compromise
threats.description: Exfiltration of the offline Root CA private key invalidates the entire trust hierarchy.
threats.mitigation: Air-gap machine, strict documented multi-person key ceremony, physical USB custody logs.

data.name:
step-ca Online
Intermediate CA
data.description: Online ACME Certificate Authority issuing short-lived leaf certificates (<=30 days).

threats.title: ACME Client Impersonation
threats.description: Attacker spoofs an internal lab endpoint to request certificates for unauthorized hostnames.
threats.mitigation: ACME challenge validation restricted to internal DNS/HTTP-01 tokens and Name Constraints.

threats.title: Intermediate CA Key Exfiltration
threats.description: Unauthorized access to container or host filesystem exposes the intermediate private key.
threats.mitigation: File permissions, non-root container execution, pathlen:0 constraint.

data.name:
NGINX Lab Services
(5+ Endpoints)
data.description: Containerized internal HTTPS endpoints managed by automated certbot/lego renewal.

threats.title: Weak Cipher / Protocol Downgrade
threats.description: Misconfigured NGINX instance allows TLS 1.0/1.1 or CBC ciphers vulnerable to plaintext recovery.
threats.mitigation: Enforce TLS 1.3 / TLS 1.2 with AEAD only via automated testssl.sh policy scanner.

threats.title: Privilege Escalation via Unrestricted Cert Scope
threats.description: Issued certificate lacks path-length or name constraints, allowing client cert to sign subordinate certs.
threats.mitigation: Intermediate CA signs end-entity certs with BasicConstraints CA:FALSE and pathlen:0.

data.name:
OCSP / CRL
Responder
data.description: Real-time revocation status responder (RFC 6960 OCSP and RFC 5280 CRL).

threats.title: OCSP Replay / Tampering Attack
threats.description: Stale 'Good' OCSP response replayed to bypass revoked certificate enforcement.
threats.mitigation: OCSP nonces enabled and short validity window for OCSP responses.

threats.title: OCSP Responder DoS Leading to Fail-Open
threats.description: Flooding OCSP responder causing clients to bypass revocation checks if soft-failing.
threats.mitigation: High availability, short CRL fallback caching, and rate limiting.

data.name:
FastAPI Inventory
& Scanner
data.description: Active TLS scanner and inventory control plane backend.

threats.title: SQL Injection in Endpoint Query Service
threats.description: Malicious search strings injected into endpoint lookup to extract or alter certificate database records.
threats.mitigation: Pydantic schema validation and strictly parameterized SQL queries in repository layer.

threats.title: Denial of Service via Scan Flooding
threats.description: Attacker floods inventory scan endpoint with connection requests to exhaust server threads.
threats.mitigation: Per-IP rate limiting and asynchronous background task queuing.

PostgreSQL DB
(Cert Inventory)

threats.title: Direct Database Modification Bypassing Audit
threats.description: Attacker with database access alters certificate status without logging in audit trails.
threats.mitigation: Append-only scan audit records and least-privilege DB connection credentials.

threats.title: Unauthorized Access to Stored Credentials
threats.description: Plaintext passwords or tokens in database exposed via unencrypted storage.
threats.mitigation: PostgreSQL TLS connections and environment variable secrets management.

threats.mitigation: TLS transport security for SMTP/Telegram webhook dispatchers.

threats.mitigation: Continuous automated querying of crt.sh API and instant alerts on unknown serial numbers.

data.name: Air-Gapped Root Boundary
data.description: Physical separation between offline Root CA and online networks

data.name: Lab Services DMZ Boundary
data.description: Network boundary isolating internal lab services from management control plane

data.name: 1. Offline Sub-CA Signing
data.description: One-time offline signing of Intermediate CA certificate during key ceremony.

threats.title: Malicious USB Drop / CSR Tampering (Air-Gap Crossing)
threats.description: Adversary tampers with the intermediate CSR or signed certificate payload on portable media crossing the air-gap boundary.
threats.mitigation: Dual-custody key ceremony, visual fingerprint comparison on air-gapped machine, cryptographic SHA-256 verifications.

threats.title: Malicious USB Drop / CSR Tampering (Air-Gap Crossing)
threats.description: Adversary tampers with the intermediate CSR or signed certificate payload on portable media crossing the air-gap boundary.
threats.mitigation: Dual-custody key ceremony, visual fingerprint comparison on air-gapped machine, cryptographic SHA-256 verifications.

data.name: 2. ACME Auto-Renewal (<=30d)
data.description: Automated ACME certificate issuance and renewal via certbot/lego.

threats.title: ACME Challenge Hijacking (DMZ Crossing)
threats.description: Attacker in DMZ intercepts or spoofs ACME HTTP-01/DNS-01 validation challenges crossing into the management CA zone.
threats.mitigation: Mutual TLS/token authentication for ACME clients, Name Constraints restricting domain issuance, and automated challenge expiry.

threats.title: ACME Challenge Hijacking (DMZ Crossing)
threats.description: Attacker in DMZ intercepts or spoofs ACME HTTP-01/DNS-01 validation challenges crossing into the management CA zone.
threats.mitigation: Mutual TLS/token authentication for ACME clients, Name Constraints restricting domain issuance, and automated challenge expiry.

data.name: 3. OCSP Nonce & Revocation Check
data.description: Clients verify certificate revocation status via OCSP responder with nonces.

threats.title: OCSP Response Replay / Stripping (DMZ Crossing)
threats.description: Man-in-the-middle on the DMZ boundary intercepts OCSP queries and replays expired 'Good' responses or drops packets to force soft-fail.
threats.mitigation: RFC 6960 OCSP nonces enforced, short OCSP validity cache (<= 1 hour), and strict client hard-fail policy on unreachable OCSP.

threats.title: OCSP Response Replay / Stripping (DMZ Crossing)
threats.description: Man-in-the-middle on the DMZ boundary intercepts OCSP queries and replays expired 'Good' responses or drops packets to force soft-fail.
threats.mitigation: RFC 6960 OCSP nonces enforced, short OCSP validity cache (<= 1 hour), and strict client hard-fail policy on unreachable OCSP.

data.name: 4. TLS Probing & Scans
data.description: FastAPI scanner actively connects to TLS endpoints to record expiry and testssl.sh grade.

threats.title: TLS Probing Interception / Forgery (DMZ Crossing)
threats.description: Untrusted entity on the DMZ boundary intercepts scanner probes or presents forged test certificates to hide real security posture.
threats.mitigation: Strict X.509 root-anchored chain verification during scans, client cert authentication, and tamper-evident scan audit logs.

threats.title: TLS Probing Interception / Forgery (DMZ Crossing)
threats.description: Untrusted entity on the DMZ boundary intercepts scanner probes or presents forged test certificates to hide real security posture.
threats.mitigation: Strict X.509 root-anchored chain verification during scans, client cert authentication, and tamper-evident scan audit logs.

data.name: 5. Store / Query Cert Records
data.description: FastAPI repository layer writes certificate metadata and queries active inventory.

data.name: 6. API Inventory Queries
data.description: Dashboard queries endpoints, displays expiry charts, and dispatches alerts at 30, 7, 1 days.

data.name: 7. Poll CT Logs
data.description: Monitoring service polls public crt.sh API to detect unauthorized or rogue public certificate issuance.

threats.title: CT Log Poisoning / Query Suppression (Internet Crossing)
threats.description: Adversary on the external Internet connection intercepts crt.sh API calls or returns forged empty responses to conceal rogue certificates.
threats.mitigation: TLS certificate pinning for crt.sh API, timeout alerts, and secondary log verifications across multiple CT providers.
